description: A continuously running line that is kept supplied with Work Orders, so nobody has to size one by hand each morning

fields.description: What the line makes. Decides which client and which finishing steps apply to it.
fields.label: Line Type

fields.description: While off, no Work Order is created automatically and the app cannot hand out units from this line.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Where raw materials are taken from. Fills only the BOM rows that name no warehouse of their own.
fields.label: Raw Material Warehouse

fields.description: Leave off for a line that finishes into stock at the bench. Switch on when a later step (packing) is what puts the unit into stock: the bench then only closes its own Job Card, and the Manufacture entry is posted by that later step, into the warehouse it names. This is what lets packing be a real BOM operation — ERPNext refuses a Manufacture entry while any operation of the Work Order is still open.
fields.label: Manufacture At Packing

fields.description: The benches this line runs at. The clients of this line offer only these workplaces, and every plan row must name one of them.
fields.label: Workplaces

fields.description: When the day's Work Orders are opened. Until then the app hands out only what is left from earlier Work Orders, or opens an overflow one.
fields.label: Plan At

fields.description: How many units an overflow Work Order covers when the day's plan runs out mid-shift. Small is safer: unused units are wasted serial numbers.
fields.label: Overflow Qty

fields.description: Close the day at the time below: delete the Job Cards nobody took and stop the day's Work Orders, so the app does not hand out a stale unit tomorrow.
fields.label: Close Stale Work Orders

fields.description: When the day is closed: Job Cards nobody took are deleted and the Work Orders opened before this moment are stopped. Must be later than the plan time.
fields.label: Close Day At

fields.description: Also delete the Serial Nos that were never produced. Off by default: deleting a serial is irreversible, and leaving it costs only a gap in the numbering.
fields.label: Delete Unused Serial Nos

name: Production Line
